title: Charter Acts: added provisions and links

boxes.title: 1813: added detail
items: Grant for ==revival of literature==, learned natives, **science**
"Officially sanctioned the propagation of **Christianity**"; **Utilitarians** also pressed

boxes.title: 1833 and 1853: added detail
items: 1833: removed curbs on ==**European immigration**== and **property purchase**
